notes: This separate instrumented ESP32-only diagnostic probe measures RAM; it is excluded from the normal 30 MiB throughput baseline. Preserved throughput fields describe only this probe and are not a recommended or representative performance result.

Snapshots query the heap with MALLOC_CAP_INTERNAL | MALLOC_CAP_8BIT. Heap free decreases include allocator metadata, RTOS objects, runtime allocations, and alignment; they differ from requested allocation sizes.

The probe pre-creates a no-op Arduino onReceive worker before constructing ReliableSerial so its heap cost can be measured separately from the Roo sender. The final receive callback and worker count match normal operation, but initialization order differs.

The initialized endpoint total is the baseline-to-sender_worker decrease. Core transport/sender and SDK UART/event worker subtotals partition that same total; sizeof values and raw buffer sizes describe parts already included and must not be added again.

The Arduino application task/stack exists before the baseline; its configured stack is not an additional part of the incremental endpoint heap total. The 256-byte pattern is static storage and is also outside this heap total.

The baseline min_free value is the earlier global low-water mark. Peak figures instead subtract the minimum of monitored post-baseline min_free rows from baseline free; the local monitor starts after the baseline snapshot.

ESP-IDF reports stack high-water free space in bytes on this target (printed sizeof(StackType_t) is 1). These readings include the diagnostic probe and are observations, not safe reduced-stack recommendations.
Reader and writer raw buffers are 64 bytes each; their combined observed heap decrease is 160 bytes. The client latency buffer requests 400 bytes and decreases free heap by 420 bytes.

After stop and an idle delay, the measured residual free-heap decreases are 304 bytes on the server and 568 bytes on the client. This single probe does not identify their ownership or establish a leak.

Control characters except newline are rendered as literal \xNN; captured Unicode replacement markers are rendered as literal \uFFFD. The rev1.1 board startup core-dump checksum warning precedes READY and remains in its transcript. Private original captures remain unchanged.

Firmware manifests retain complete relative-path source hashes and build flags; copied instrumented source SHA256s exactly match each manifest src/main.cpp. Repository HEADs identify build provenance; source hashes identify the actual snapshot.

throughput_receive_buffer.reason: The later snapshot also includes runtime changes after floating-point latency formatting; subtracting neighboring snapshots does not isolate this allocation.
